How I work

This is how I did it on With You.

  1. Research before drawing

    I review sources and interview people to turn findings into decisions. On With You the interviews were simulated, and the case says so.

    See it in the case

  2. Prototype to decide

    Low-fidelity wireframes to set the structure before color, and an interactive prototype in Figma.

    See it in the case

  3. Test and change

    A three-task test showed that “Historial” was confusing. It became “Mi progreso”.

    See it in the case

  4. Leave a system behind

    I audited my own kit against WCAG 2.2 AA and rebuilt it with variables and components with states.

    See it in the case

About me

I studied Industrial Design at UANL and for more than four years I designed, built and coordinated physical product projects end to end, working with clients, suppliers and production teams.

That process, understanding what people need, prototyping, validating and iterating, is what I now apply to digital products.
